references.observations: Photographs on physical PDF pages 70–71 inspected. Text specifies 30.88 by 44.21 m parcel, H-shaped floor plan, seven-storey bow-window body, three-storey green mansard, and passage 7.5 m wide by 13.5 m high. Dome height is given as 86 m, conflicting with owner's 90 m. Publication is linked, not redistributed.

Front projecting polygonal windows and rounded balconies; four mansard window strips per side, round upper openings; paired tower pilasters, pointed arch, layered cornices and lantern glazing/searchlight. Photographs are references only.
